verdict.rationale: Granola's docs describe a Zapier integration that connects notes to 8,000+ apps and automates post-meeting work, which covers the 'thousands of apps' part of the story. Granola Chat can also draft and send Slack messages, so Slack is reachable. However, there is no evidence of automatic note flow into Slack channels or of a native Notion integration. Missing for 10: native Notion page sync, automatic posting of notes to Slack channels rather than chat-initiated messages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the integrations.
